fable_5.description: Claude Fable 5 (claude-fable-5) — Mythos-class, most capable GA model, above Opus 4.8. 1M context, 128K output, $10/$50 per MTok. CLI aliases: 'fable' and 'claude-fable-5'. Adaptive thinking always-on (thinking:{type:'disabled'} returns HTTP 400 — omit the param); no temperature/top_p; refusals return stop_reason:'refusal' as HTTP 200. SECURITY NOTE: built-in real-time cyber/biology safety classifier auto-switches the session to Opus 4.8 on flagged content (false positives common) — do NOT default Sentinel orchestration to Fable 5; pin Opus 4.8 or apply to the Cyber Verification Program.

Security-relevant: disables hook/MCP/skill-based controls — a monitoring/guardrail bypass vector if set in shared envs.

glob_deny_rules.description: Permission deny rules support glob patterns (e.g. '*' denies all tools) for whitelist-style configs; allow rules reject non-MCP globs and a startup warning shows for unknown tool names in deny rules. Hardening primitive for least-privilege policies.

skills_context_fork_background.description: Skills with context: fork run in the background by default; background:false to opt out

nested_claude_skills_dirs.description: Skills in nested .claude/skills load when working on files there; <dir>:<name> on name clash

skill_frontmatter_boolean_forms.description: yes/no/on/off/1/0 accepted for skill and plugin frontmatter booleans

dataviz_skill.description: /dataviz skill for chart and dashboard design with a runnable color-palette validator

no_auto_verify_code_review.description: Claude no longer runs /verify and /code-review on its own; invoke explicitly

code_review_background_subagent.description: /code-review runs as a background subagent, keeping stacked slash commands as its review target

fork_background_session.description: /fork copies the conversation into a new background session; the in-session variant is now /subtask

resume_picker_agent_view.description: /resume in the agent view opens a picker of past sessions, incl. deleted, resumed as background

rewind_before_clear.description: /rewind can resume a conversation from before /clear was run

end_conversation_tool.description: EndConversation tool: Claude can end sessions with highly abusive users or jailbreak attempts

screen_reader_mode.description: Opt-in plain-text rendering via --ax-screen-reader, CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER=1 or axScreenReader

doctor_claude_md_trim.description: /doctor check proposing to trim checked-in CLAUDE.md content Claude could derive from the codebase

enter_worktree_confirmation.description: EnterWorktree confirms before entering a worktree outside .claude/worktrees/

process_wrapper.description: CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER runs every Claude Code self-spawn through a required wrapper executable

client_presence_file.description: CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE suppresses mobile push notifications while you are at the machine

ask_user_question_no_autocontinue.description: AskUserQuestion dialogs no longer auto-continue by default; idle timeout is opt-in via /config

background_agent_auto_pr.description: Background agents from claude agents commit, push and open a draft PR when finishing worktree code work

memory_modified_timestamp.description: ISO modified timestamp added to memory file frontmatter

transcript_write_warnings.description: Warnings when transcript writes fail or session saving is off, instead of losing transcripts silently
